cell_note: each cell is [n, mean_mwpa] (wins, realized, league windows from the state); a cell is thin, and prices no decision, when n is below min_cell
what_this_is: baseline_f(S) = the league mean realized window mWPA over every window of the same shape from state S, decision or not; DVS(d) = mWPA(d) - baseline_f(S(d)). Removes the level of the state, not player quality and not selection. Descriptive, not skill.
identity: within every cell the residuals of the league windows sum to zero by construction; identity_max_abs is the largest absolute mean residual found, checked not asserted

selection_caveat.intentional_walk: intentional walks are given to the hitters a manager least wants to face, so the state-matched mean of pitching to him is measured over weaker batters and is biased FOR the walk. Stated, not solved.
selection_caveat.pinch_hit: a pinch hitter is sent up for the batters a manager least wants at the plate, so the state-matched league plate appearance is a different population of hitters from the ones lifted. Stated, not solved.

single_pa_caveat: for the single-plate-appearance families (pinch hit, bunt) the baseline is the league mean realized change over every plate appearance from the same state, which a calibrated win model puts near zero, so DVS there is mWPA plus the feed model's local miscalibration and is NOT an independent second number; it differs materially only for the stint-length windows (pitching change, pinch run, intentional walk). The steal has no DVS.
where_dvs_lives: the per-decision drill-down and the League census only; never a column on a club-season or manager row
